prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: production browser RPG bridge-deck sprite / repeatable surface, not a scene or concept sheet.
Create a single wide rectangular wooden footbridge deck seen in strict orthographic top-down view. The entire canvas is the bridge surface, full bleed: no surrounding ground, no water, no sky, no empty margin, no transparency, no checkerboard. Travel runs horizontally from left edge to right edge. Rich hand-painted warm oak cross-planks run vertically across the deck, with readable grain, irregular joins, worn rounded bevels, iron nail heads and subtle moss only along the outer edges. The upper and lower 12 percent of the image contain solid continuous chunky wooden guard beams and rope-bound low posts at regular intervals, aligned exactly with the image edges; the middle 76 percent is unobstructed walkable planks. All wood surface fills the complete rectangle. Both horizontal ends are open and flush, so copies can extend a long span. This rectangular sprite will be rotated and mapped directly to the game's walkable bridge geometry.
Style: polished cozy fantasy RPG scenery, tactile painterly volume, restrained warm cream highlights, cool dark-brown crevices, soft upper-left light, illustrated rather than flat geometric. Match the mood of mossy handmade village bridges without adding any scenery. Crisp at small game scale. Wide landscape canvas about 3:1. No perspective convergence, no diagonal/isometric deck, no text, no logos, no watermark, no people or creatures.
integration: Original opaque rectangular sprite, no bitmap cleanup or editing. Runtime drawing maps it to bridge geometry; guard beams lie outside the walkable strip.
approval: Technical integration and agent visual review; owner/commercial acceptance pending.
